Our Company

About us

Good Korean beauty deserves a home in Indonesia.

Skincara partners with Korean beauty brands to bring their vision closer to Indonesian consumers. With deep local market knowledge, regulatory expertise, and strong retail partnerships, we make entering and growing in Indonesia simpler.

We believe in building brands, not just moving products. Every partnership is built on trust, shared ambition, and respect for what makes each brand unique.

Korean and Indonesian at the core

Our founders are Korean and Indonesian. We understand what a Korean brand is aiming for, and we know Indonesian culture, shoppers and retail from the inside.

Regulation handled end to end

BPOM cosmetic notification, halal certification, Indonesian-language labelling and import permits are run in-house, so launches don't stall at customs.

Established retail access

Long-standing relationships with Indonesia's leading beauty retailers put partner brands in front of the right shoppers, online and in store, with campaigns planned together.

Our Story

Built from the ground up

Skincara didn't begin with a big office or a big budget. It began with a belief that Indonesian shoppers deserved the best of Korean beauty, and the patience to build it brand by brand.

  1. Starting from nothing

    Our co-founder Franseda Natalio started with no network, no warehouse and no brands. Only the conviction that Korean skincare would matter to Indonesians.

  2. The first K‑beauty wave

    Through his early work with Nature Republic, Franseda was part of the movement that turned Korean skincare into a daily habit across Indonesia.

  3. Reading the shift

    Shoppers changed. They now discover, compare and buy many brands in one place, and single-brand stores became harder to sustain.

  4. One agency, many brands

    So we built Skincara as a multibrand importer and distribution agency: one partner that brings many Korean brands to where Indonesians actually shop.

Brand & Services

Partnership

One partner for the whole journey into Indonesia. Pick the full service or the parts your brand needs.

Exclusive Brand Partnership

Your sole partner in Indonesia

We become the brand's exclusive importer and distributor, with a joint business plan covering range selection, pricing architecture, launch timing and annual targets.

  • Exclusive distribution
  • Range & pricing plan
  • Annual business review

Regulatory & Import

BPOM, halal and import licensing

We prepare the dossier, file BPOM cosmetic notifications, coordinate halal certification and handle Indonesian labelling, so every SKU enters the market compliant.

  • BPOM notification
  • Halal certification
  • Label localisation
  • Customs & import permits

Omnichannel Distribution

Online, offline and social

Leading beauty retail, online and offline, forms the core channel. We extend reach through marketplaces and social commerce where it supports the brand, and analyse each channel's shopper to tailor assortment and promotions.

  • Beauty retail & e-commerce
  • Marketplaces
  • Social & live commerce

Brand Growth & Marketing

Launch, activate, grow

Local launch campaigns, KOL and creator seeding, in-store activation and promotion calendars built around Indonesian shopping moments. Sales data feeds the next range decision.

  • KOL & creator seeding
  • Campaign calendar
  • Sell-out reporting

Supply Chain & Account Management

Stock in the right place

Purchase orders, forecasting, warehousing and replenishment to retail, with one account manager per brand as the day-to-day contact for the Korean team.

  • PO & forecasting
  • Warehousing
  • Dedicated account manager

How a partnership starts

From first meeting to the shelf

  1. Brand fit review

    We review range, pricing and positioning against Indonesian demand.

  2. Business plan

    Hero SKUs, price points, targets and exclusivity terms agreed.

  3. Registration

    BPOM notification, halal and label localisation for each SKU.

  4. Import & launch

    First shipment, retail listing and launch campaign.

  5. Growth

    Monthly sell-out review, range extension and channel expansion.
